Consider the reaction $aX \rightarrow bY$, for which the rate constant at $30^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ is $1 \times 10^{-3} \, \mathrm{mol}^{-1} \, \mathrm{Ls}^{-1}$. Which of the following statements are true ?
A. When concentration of ' X ' is increased to four times, the rate of reaction becomes 16 times.
B. The reaction is a second order reaction.
C. The half-life period is independent of the concentration of X .
D. Decomposition of $\mathrm{N}_2 \, \mathrm{O}_5$ is an example of the above reaction.
E. is valid for the above reaction.

image.alt: Figure for this Chemical Kinetics question

options.label: C
options.content: A, B, D and E only
